ref: KHAN: khach iOS nhap code xong KHONG VAO DUOC APP (dung o man dang nhap). NGUYEN NHAN GOC (do tren chinh IPA dang phat 1.4.0 build 16, 8.135.823 B): code signature cua app+extension khai keychain-access-groups = G6XW3RN6LJ.com.privatevpn.shared, NHUNG embedded.mobileprovision chi cap G6XW3RN6LJ.com.privatevpn.app (app) va G6XW3RN6LJ.com.privatevpn.app.packet-tunnel (extension) - KHONG co .shared. iOS cap nhom theo PROFILE => SecItemAdd tra errSecMissingEntitlement (-34018) => AuthSessionStore.save() (iOS/PrivateVPN/Services/AuthSessionStore.swift:27-36) nuot loi va KHONG set session => isSignedIn=false => dung o man dang nhap. Cung loi nay lam khoa WireGuard khong luu duoc => tunnel khong dung duoc. VI SAO LOT: lenh verify cu chi soi code signature (co .shared nen PASS) ma khong soi profile. DA VA: scripts/check-publish-version.py --platform ios nay kiem CA HAI va chan (da chay thu tren IPA loi: KHONG DAT - Nhom keychain THIEU trong profile); docs/PUBLISHER_PROCESS.md §2 sua dong verify; docs/IOS_INSTALL_TROUBLESHOOTING.md §0a ghi chan doan + cach sua. CACH SUA (Apple Developer portal, may Mac): (1) Identifiers -> App ID com.privatevpn.app -> bat Keychain Sharing -> them nhom G6XW3RN6LJ.com.privatevpn.shared; (2) lam y het cho com.privatevpn.app.packet-tunnel (app + extension PHAI cung nhom); (3) sinh lai profile Ad Hoc/development => profile phai chua .shared; (4) ky lai IPA (scripts/ios-resign-ipa.sh) roi verify bang cong; (5) test tren iPhone THAT truoc khi phat. Neu portal khong cho tao nhom .shared thi doi KeychainStore.accessGroup sang nhom profile that su cap - nhung phai cung nhom o ca app lan extension.
